name: Restaurants & Hospitality
summary: Brand-forward, fast websites that turn hungry browsers into booked tables.
painPoints: Diners decide on a phone - slow, clunky sites lose them
Menus and hours change, but updates need a developer
Hard to rank for local searches that bring covers in
Booking and ordering live on someone else's platform
body:
Hospitality is decided in seconds, usually on a phone. We build mobile-first sites that load instantly, look as considered as the room, and put the menu, story, and booking a tap apart.

Everything is editable without a developer - menus, hours, and specials - and structured so you rank for the local searches that actually fill tables. We can integrate the booking and ordering tools you already use, or build something cleaner.

The result is a site that does more than look good: it brings people through the door.

## What replaces what

Most restaurant sites either live on a page builder that owns the account, or a booking and ordering platform that takes a cut of every table and every order on top of a monthly fee. What gets built here is the same as everything else on this site: the code, the domain and the hosting account come to you, and running it costs a few dollars a month rather than a percentage of every booking.

## Who this suits

Restaurants and hospitality brands that want the menu changed the same day a price does, that are tired of a booking widget taking a cut of every table, and that want a site that looks like the room rather than a template every competitor is also using.
seoDescription: Fast, brand-forward restaurant websites with menus, local SEO, and frictionless booking - built and editable without code.

name: Health & Fitness
summary: Web apps and sites that turn coaching and care into a guided client experience.
painPoints: Coaching doesn't scale past the hours in a day
Clients lose momentum between sessions
Spreadsheets and DMs instead of one clear product
Generic tools that don't fit your method
body:
Great coaching is personal - but it shouldn't be trapped in spreadsheets and DMs. We design and build products that turn your method into a clear, guided experience clients actually stick with.

From plans and progress to day-to-day actions, we build on a modern, type-safe stack that works on the gym floor and scales as you grow. The interface stays out of the way so the training does the talking.

Whether it's a marketing site or a full web app, it's delivered end to end by one senior team.

## What replaces what

Coaches and studios usually end up on a generic fitness app subscription that charges per client and looks the same for every gym on the platform. What gets built here is yours: the plans, the client progress tracking and the branding are specific to how you actually coach, and the code and hosting belong to you rather than to the app's monthly bill.

## Who this suits

Coaches and studios whose method does not fit a generic template, who are paying per client for software that looks like everyone else's, and who want the product to scale with their client list without the price scaling faster than revenue does.
seoTitle: Web Apps for Health & Fitness Businesses
seoDescription: Production-grade fitness web apps and sites that scale coaching, boost retention, and feel effortless for clients.

name: SaaS & Startups
summary: Senior product teams that help startups ship and scale without the rewrite.
painPoints: Speed to market matters, but quality can't slip
Early shortcuts become expensive technical debt
Onboarding and activation leak users
Hiring a senior team takes months
body:
Startups live and die on momentum. We embed as a senior product team - designing, building, and shipping in tight iterations - so you move fast without mortgaging the future.

We architect for scale from day one: clean data models, real auth and roles, and the AI and automation that give small teams outsized leverage. When you raise or grow, the foundation holds.

One accountable team, from the first sketch to the last deploy.

## What replaces what

Early technical debt is usually the result of speed bought at the cost of ownership: a low code platform, a template that cannot be extended, or a contractor who is the only one who understands the codebase. What gets built here is a normal, documented Next.js and TypeScript codebase from the first commit, so the team you hire next, whether that is us or your own engineers, can pick it up without a rewrite.

## Who this suits

Founders who need to move fast without accumulating debt they will have to unwind before a raise, and who would rather own a smaller, well built product than rent a larger one from a platform that can change its pricing under them.
seoDescription: Senior-only product team for SaaS and startups - ship fast, scale cleanly, and build AI-native from day one.

name: E-commerce & Retail
summary: Storefronts engineered for speed, trust, and conversion.
painPoints: Every 100ms of load time costs sales
Traffic arrives but carts get abandoned
Catalog updates are slow and painful
SEO and performance fight each other
body:
In retail, speed is revenue. We build storefronts that load instantly, earn trust, and guide shoppers to checkout without friction.

Performance, accessibility, and SEO are built in - not bolted on - so you rank and convert at the same time. We automate the repetitive work behind the scenes, from catalog syncs to post-purchase flows.

The outcome is a store that feels fast and sells more.

## What replaces what

Most storefronts run on a platform that takes a percentage of every sale on top of a monthly fee, in exchange for templates you do not own and a checkout you cannot fully customise. What gets built here runs on your own hosting for a few dollars a month, with no per transaction cut, and a catalogue and checkout built around how your store actually sells.

## Who this suits

Retailers who have outgrown a template storefront, who are paying a percentage of revenue for hosting that costs a fraction of that on its own, and who want performance and SEO treated as part of the build rather than a paid app added afterwards.
seoDescription: Fast, high-converting storefronts with performance, SEO, and automation built in for retail and e-commerce brands.

name: Professional Services
summary: Credible sites and automations that win and qualify better clients.
painPoints: The site doesn't reflect the quality of the work
Leads arrive unqualified and slow to follow up
Manual admin eats billable hours
Hard to stand out from look-alike competitors
body:
For firms that sell expertise, the website is the first impression - and often the deciding one. We build credible, distinctive sites that reflect the quality of your work and turn visitors into qualified enquiries.

Behind the scenes, we automate the busywork: qualifying leads, routing enquiries, and following up - so your team spends time on clients, not admin.

Brand, build, and growth, handled by one senior team.

## What replaces what

Firms that sell expertise are often the worst served by template builders, because the site is meant to signal judgment and instead looks like every competitor's. What gets built here is distinctive by construction rather than by a theme choice, and the code and hosting account belong to the firm, not to a subscription that stops the moment payments do.

## Who this suits

Firms where the website is genuinely the first impression a prospective client forms, where unqualified enquiries are costing billable time, and where the current site was built once and never revisited because nobody owns it enough to bother.
seoDescription: Credible, distinctive websites and automations that help professional services firms win and qualify better clients.

name: Real Estate
summary: Listings and lead engines that are fast to browse and faster to convert.
painPoints: Listing search is slow and clunky on mobile
Leads aren't routed or followed up fast enough
Sites buckle under large, changing inventories
Generic templates that look like everyone else
body:
Property is browsed on the move and decided fast. We build listing experiences that are quick to search, beautiful on mobile, and built to handle large, changing inventories.

We wire in fast lead capture and routing - and the integrations that connect your CRM and portals - so no enquiry slips through. Performance and SEO bring the right buyers in.

A site and system built to convert, not just display.

## What replaces what

Property sites are frequently built on a portal integrated platform that charges monthly for the privilege of listing your own inventory, with performance that degrades as the catalogue grows. What gets built here is engineered to stay fast at scale, with CRM and portal integrations wired in rather than paid for as add-ons, on hosting that costs a few dollars a month regardless of how many listings are live.

## Who this suits

Agencies and agents whose current site slows down as their inventory grows, who are paying monthly for a platform that owns the listing data, and who want lead capture and routing built to their process rather than a generic form.
seoDescription: Fast, mobile-first real estate websites and lead engines with search, CRM integration, and SEO built in.
